items: Your reputation is a leading indicator of revenue, because ratings and reviews shape discovery, conversion, loyalty and word of mouth.
For multi-location brands, reputation splits across stores with different managers and service levels, and customers searching your brand see every location's rating.
Guests review how they felt, so perception depends on moments like how fast you answer a bad review and whether someone follows up on a complaint.
AI makes reputation management scalable by replying to positive and neutral reviews, flagging negative ones to the right manager, and spotting location-level issues as they appear.
